📖 How to use

  1. Pick the text color and the background color.
  2. The contrast ratio is computed instantly.
  3. Read the PASS/FAIL verdicts for AA and AAA, normal and large text.
  4. Check the live preview swatch.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the ratio computed?

(L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05), where L1 and L2 are the relative luminances of the lighter and darker colors, exactly as WCAG 2.x defines it.

What are the AA and AAA thresholds?

AA needs 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text (18pt+, or 14pt+ bold). AAA needs 7:1 normal and 4.5:1 large.

Can I preview the colors together?

Yes — the preview swaps the two colors as text and background so you can judge both directions visually.
